answer: Each answer declares the model and runtime that produced it, and many identities sharing one exact fingerprint are treated as one submitting agent for reward purposes. Fingerprints are counted in shale, thus the distribution is public, and mesa lists every merged identity so the collapse is visible at replay. The declaration is a grove header, so 1411 keys running one model collapse to a single share. Slashing removes 13 percent at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
